features.title: Ten new original cave pieces
features.description: Search for grotto to find flowstone and crystal walls, fungi, a weathered entrance, rocky floors, a mineral pool, a fluted column and an eroded ramp.

features.title: Sculpted detail and OpenLOCK
features.description: The relief is part of the printable geometry. Every new piece includes integrated official-template OpenLOCK sockets. Fit-test your printer before a full scene.
